column1: Inland Revenue (Amendment)
Act, No. 8 of 2005
“primary market transaction” means the purchase
of any Security or Treasury Bond issued under
the  Registered  Stock  and  Securities
Ordinance  (Chapter  420),  or  Treasury  Bill
issued  under  the  Local  Treasury  Bills
Ordinance  (Chapter  417),  or  Central  Bank
Security issued under the Monetary Law Act,
(Chapter 422) at the time of the original issue
of  such  Security,  Bill  or  Bond  or  by  any
primary  dealer  subject  to  any  discount  or
payment of interest by the issuer ; and
“secondary market transaction” means the sale
of a security or other instruments referred to
in sub-paragraph (b) of subsection (1B) of this
section or re-purchase or reverse re-purchase
of such security or other instruments after the
original issue of such security or holding of
any such security or instrument for a period
longer  than  one  day  from  the  date  of
acquisition, by any primary dealer who has
acquired such security or other instruments.” ;
